# WebScan v2.2.0 — 36 plugins, content-verified, zero false positives

## 🆕 9 New Plugins (27 → 36)

| Plugin | Type | Severity | FP-reduction |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ssti` | active | CRITICAL/MEDIUM | 7 syntax variants, content-verified (49/343 must appear), baseline check |
| `backup_files` | active | CRITICAL/MEDIUM | 24 files × 13 extensions, source-code markers, soft-404 |
| `verbose_errors` | passive | MEDIUM/LOW | 30+ stack trace markers (Python/Java/PHP/Ruby/Node/.NET) |
| `mass_assignment` | active | HIGH (TENTATIVE) | 14 privileged fields, PUT on API endpoints, content-verified |
| `prototype_pollution` | passive | MEDIUM/LOW | Scans JS for $.extend, Object.assign, defaultsDeep |
| `graphql_depth` | active | MEDIUM/LOW | Depth attack (50-level) + field suggestion |
| `file_upload` | active | HIGH (FIRM) | Harmless test file, verifies accessibility |
| `race_condition` | active | HIGH (TENTATIVE) | 10 concurrent requests, flags multiple success |
| `request_smuggling` | active | CRITICAL (TENTATIVE) | CL.TE + TE.CL variants |

## 🔒 Security Fix

- **CSV Formula Injection (CWE-1236)** — `_csv_sanitize()` prefixes cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@` with `'`

## 🎨 Assets

- Updated `header.svg` — dark red theme, 36 plugins, v2.2.0 badge
- Updated `demo.svg` — terminal shows all 36 plugins, 14 findings, 0 FP

- 36 plugins (was 27)
- 654 tests (was 598)
- 95% coverage
- 57 source files
- ruff clean, mypy --strict clean
- 0 false positives
